marie_p: heads-up — ACME reports quant/perf regressions on A100 after driver 535.x + CUDA 12.3 update. requesting guidance for marketplace and Dedicated images.
jess_acme: SI is blocked on cert for marketplace image; noisy int8 errors in prod. need pin + ETA for hotfix.
david_p: saw same in nightly: fused-kernel change in CUDA12.3 triggers regressions when driver >=535.2.
rachel_eng: short-term: pin hosts to driver 534.x + CUDA12.2 for marketplace & dedicated. long-term: runtime fallback for affected kernels.
sam_sre: we can run a canary 03:00 UTC. propose:
- marketplace: pin driver 534.86 + CUDA12.2
- dedicated: opt-in tenant config for 534 pin
- fallback route to quant-safe model variant on failure signal
opsbot: CI alert nightly-inference-a100: perf/quant/roundtrip_check delta +18% (kernel fuser mismatch).
marie_p: need exact pin snippet + quick rollback steps to share with partners.
david_p: snippet to circulate:
DRIVER_VERSION=534.86
CUDA_VERSION=12.2.1
FROM nvidia/cuda:${CUDA_VERSION}-runtime-ubuntu22.04
Rollback: boot host to prev driver, redeploy image tag redwood/inference:cuda12.2-pin-20260320
jess_acme: OK. ETA for patch?
rachel_eng: PR for fused-kernel guard in review; if CI passes we can cut hotfix and vendor patch by 2026-03-21 EOD+1. ops to sign/push images within 24h.
sam_sre: will run 10% canary; abort if >3% error or CPU spike >20%.
marie_p: I'll draft partner comms (pins, canary dates, rollback, FAQ). tag @jess_acme.
jess_acme: please confirm signed driver binaries for air-gapped installs.
rachel_eng: yes — signed artifacts + checksum manifest and offline installer steps.
david_p: actions: rachel publish artifacts by 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC; sam publish canary plan by 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC; marie publish comms by 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC; jess confirm SI window ASAP.
opsbot: scheduled canary canary/a100-quant-pin-20260321 runs 2026-03-21T03:00Z.
marie_p: include telemetry snippet in comms for quick triage.
jess_acme: will do; thanks team :raised_hands:
